title: revise --json output, schema 1
description: One envelope per invocation. Fields may be added within schema 1; consumers ignore unknown fields.

command.description: replace-text is the 3.0 name, reported when a command is run under it.

sourceFidelity.description: How an export would relate to the .docx the document came from; null for other formats.

view.description: How pending tracked changes read: tracked shows them, accepted and original as if every one were accepted or rejected.

result.description: The tool's own result; see revise tools <name>.

view.description: read and search: the view html and matches show. Absent for other tools.

viewMatches.description: search: blocks the search tool can't see in this view. Tracked: matches inside deleted text. Original: every match in the original text (no search_result_id).

regions.description: Occurrences replaced per part of the document; parts with none are left out.

nearMisses.description: Text that looser matching would have replaced: other capitalization (--ignore-case) or other quotes and spaces (without --exact).

copiedFrom.description: With --out: the original file the copy was made from (absolute path); the edit went to `file`. Otherwise null.

trackedChangeCount.description: Tracked changes in the written file, as revise reads it back; 0 for formats that can't hold them; null if a .docx could not be read back.

checkpoint.description: null when setting up the new file failed after it was written (exit 2).

input.description: null when the document came from stdin (-).

inputFormat.description: The format read: from --from, recognized from stdin's bytes, or from the input's extension.

reference.description: The reference file printed (--reference), or null for SKILL.md itself.
